evaluations.rationale: High fidelity to book beats with consistent Buck visuals (brown muzzle, white blaze) and explicit sound cues in every scene; minor pacing compression for clip length.
evaluations.promptImprovementSuggestion: Add an explicit rule requiring every recurring character to have 2-3 locked visual traits restated in the first action line of any scene after a time gap or re-entry.

evaluations.rationale: Excessive summarization drops key beats and reduces visual specificity; character descriptions lack consistent locking across scenes.
evaluations.promptImprovementSuggestion: Add an explicit rule that every scene must contain at least one concrete camera-observable action line before any dialogue or V.O., with no more than two distinct actions per scene heading.

evaluations.rationale: Exceptional fidelity with detailed book-accurate visuals, consistent character traits, and interleaved sound cues; strong clip-friendly breakdown.
evaluations.promptImprovementSuggestion: Add an explicit rule requiring at least one (SOUND:) or (MUSIC:) cue in every scene, with two distinct audio beats at major emotional peaks.

evaluations.rationale: Solid coverage but some paraphrased dialogue and less consistent visual locking for Buck; sound cues present but pacing occasionally rushed.
evaluations.promptImprovementSuggestion: Add an explicit rule to prefer exact book wording for iconic lines and limit paraphrasing to whole-beat cuts only.

evaluations.rationale: Strong fidelity and consistent Buck description with good sound integration; minor compression in later trail sections affects pacing slightly.
evaluations.promptImprovementSuggestion: Add an explicit rule that when a single V.O. passage exceeds three sentences over one static action line, it must be broken with a one-line visual or sound micro-beat.

evaluations.rationale: Good fidelity with consistent visuals and sound cues; pacing works for clips but some transitions feel abrupt in mail-hauling sections.
evaluations.promptImprovementSuggestion: Add an explicit rule to merge consecutive beats sharing the same location and time of day into one scene unless place, time, or dramatic purpose clearly changes.

evaluations.rationale: Excellent fidelity, locked visuals for Buck, concrete actions, and strong sound design; pacing and transitions optimized for short clips.
evaluations.promptImprovementSuggestion: Add an explicit rule requiring a short closing beat returning to any established on-camera frame immediately before FADE OUT, unless no such frame was ever established.

judgeSummaryNotes: Strongest: Screenplay C because of superior fidelity, consistent character visuals, and clip-optimized structure with explicit sound cues. Weakest: Screenplay B because of excessive summarization that drops beats and lacks consistent visual locking for characters.
